description: CAP (vnebolnichnaya pnevmoniya, J18) in adult with stated penicillin allergy. The allergy class is resolved through the curated allergy_class_hierarchy: amoxicillin via the class map, unmapped_pen via its own class label ('Полусинтетические пенициллины широкого спектра' -> family 'Пенициллины'). Both are excluded, and no ALLERGY_UNVERIFIABLE is emitted, because the class IS verifiable. Measurable physician benefit: prevents contraindicated beta-lactams reliably, reduces UNVERIFIABLE warnings, full traceability of the terminology mapping (the resolving source is recorded in the exclusion trace).
